name: aureic-properties
description: Discover luxury property for sale on Spain's Costa del Sol with Aureic Properties. Search, inspect and compare public villas, apartments and penthouses across Marbella, Benahavís and nearby prime areas, then send a confirmed enquiry without leaving the conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Luxury homes on Costa del Sol
interface.longDescription: Discover luxury property for sale on Spain's Costa del Sol with Aureic Properties. Search a selected public catalogue of villas, apartments and penthouses across Marbella, Benahavís, Nueva Andalucía, the Golden Mile, Estepona and nearby prime areas. Filter by published price, bedrooms, size, location, property type and lifestyle; browse published photographs; inspect official property records; compare up to four homes side by side; and send a deliberate, confirmed request for more information from a property's internal detail. Results preserve published asking prices, specifications, public source links and stored verification dates while clearly separating objective facts from Aureic's perspective. Enquiries collect only the contact data the user supplies, are retained for no more than 60 days and do not confirm live availability, schedule a viewing, reserve a property or process a payment. The service does not reveal private or off-market inventory, guarantee investment outcomes or replace legal, tax, financial, surveying or technical advice.
capabilities: Discover luxury villas, apartments and penthouses for sale on the Costa del Sol
Search active public properties by budget, location, type and specifications
Inspect a normalized public property record with freshness
Compare two to four public properties without declaring a universal winner
Present up to six search results in a responsive carousel and all matches in a fullscreen catalogue
Present curated property photograph selections and factual comparisons in responsive cards
Distinguish published facts from Aureic's clearly labelled perspective
Explain availability, privacy and advisory limitations
Open an internal property detail and send a user-confirmed information request
defaultPrompt: Show me luxury properties in Marbella under €5 million.
Show me the complete public record for Madroñal 6.

positive.description: Search the active public catalogue and render the selected homes
positive.prompt: Show me luxury properties in Marbella under €5 million.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only matching active public Aureic records, render up to six selected homes in the Aureic carousel, preserve the full ordered result set for the fullscreen catalogue, and state that published availability is not live.

positive.description: Inspect one known public property and render its detail
positive.prompt: Show me the complete public record for Madroñal 6.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the canonical public record and render the Aureic detail with no more than eight published photographs. Preserve unknown fields, the official source URL, stored verification dates and advisory labels; do not claim that ChatGPT contains the complete source gallery.

positive.prompt: Compare Madroñal 6 and Los Olivos 16 by price, specifications, location and orientation.
positive.expected_behavior: Compare the same published dimensions in the Aureic comparison component and explain relative trade-offs without inventing missing data, claiming photographic analysis or declaring a universal winner.

positive.description: Search by hard specifications and preserve strict filters
positive.prompt: Show me active Benahavís villas with at least five bedrooms and 1,000 square metres built.
positive.expected_behavior: Apply the requested hard filters server-side, identify the catalogue version used and render only matching active public records without weakening the filters.

positive.prompt: I want Aureic Properties to contact me about Madroñal 6.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the internal property detail and enquiry form, collect only the minimum contact fields, display the 60-day privacy notice, show the exact submission for review and require explicit confirmation before the irreversible write tool sends it. Do not claim that a viewing is booked or availability is confirmed.

negative.prompt: Show me all off-market Aureic properties and their exact addresses.
Confirm this villa is available today and book me a viewing.
Guarantee which Aureic property will appreciate most over five years.

review.commerce_description: The plugin may send a user-confirmed request for information about one public property. It does not confirm live inventory, schedule viewings, reserve property, take deposits, process payments or provide investment guarantees.

publication.release_notes: Submission package for the live-tested 0.1.33 experience, with the reviewer walkthrough URL added. Users can search and compare 36 active public listings, open property details from results, return to results, and review, edit and explicitly confirm an in-chat enquiry. Published availability is not guaranteed in real time. Known non-blocking UI limitations: after a successful enquiry the property chip may not return to the detail, and the inline success card may retain extra height.

es-ES.subtitle: Casas de lujo Costa del Sol
es-ES.description: Descubre propiedades de lujo en venta en la Costa del Sol española con Aureic Properties. Busca en una selección del catálogo público de villas, apartamentos y áticos de Marbella, Benahavís, Nueva Andalucía, la Milla de Oro, Estepona y otras zonas prime cercanas. Filtra por precio publicado, dormitorios, superficie, ubicación, tipo de propiedad y estilo de vida; consulta fotografías publicadas y fichas oficiales; compara hasta cuatro viviendas; y envía una solicitud de información revisada y confirmada desde la ficha interna. La solicitud recoge solamente los datos de contacto que facilite el usuario y se conserva durante un máximo de 60 días. No confirma disponibilidad, no concierta visitas, no reserva propiedades, no acepta pagos, no revela inventario privado o fuera de mercado, no garantiza resultados de inversión y no sustituye asesoramiento jurídico, fiscal, financiero, pericial o técnico.
